description: Fit a different Face Display module: "ssd1306" (0.96" 128×64 monochrome OLED, I²C; default), "ssd1331" (0.95" 96×64 colour RGB OLED, SPI) or "st7789" (1.3" 240×240 colour IPS TFT, SPI). Faces and text adapt to the resolution; colour modules show a colour per emotion. `panel` changes the SSD1306 glass colour. Returns read_display.

panel.description: SSD1306 panel colour: yellow-blue (top 16 rows yellow, rest blue; the default), white, blue or yellow

name: set_display
title: Choose the display module
